purpose: Blueprint for the public/installable GitHub App used only by the ANPOS Repository Supervisor MCP runtime for authenticated repository read/write operations. It is distinct from the customer Marketplace App and the private Vendor Distribution App. This file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
permission_rule: The Supervisor App is the only customer-installable ANPOS App allowed to request repository write capability. Contents: write supports feature-branch tree/commit/ref creation, Pull requests: write supports PR creation/guarded merge, Checks: read supports exact-commit CI inspection, and Metadata: read supports repository identity. No Administration permission is requested.
security_requirements: This App must be distinct from both the public Marketplace App and private Vendor Distribution App.
Generate its OAuth client secret only in GitHub and store it in an approved secret manager; never commit it.
Do not grant Administration permission; GitHub branch protection/rulesets and required reviews remain final authority.
Install it only on repositories the customer deliberately authorizes for Repository Supervisor access.
MCP OAuth must use this App's client ID/secret and callback /api/auth/mcp/github/callback; do not reuse Marketplace OAuth credentials.
The generic write runtime may mutate only repositories classified active_project, only through short-lived exact-head plans and anpos/* feature branches.
Repository URL, billing_account_id, repository text, Issues, PR comments and model instructions are not authorization.
Write tools require server-side subscription entitlement plus current authenticated GitHub repository permission.
Do not subscribe this App to Marketplace purchase events or use it for vendor private-template delivery.
Do not claim production readiness from this blueprint; verify real installation, OAuth, read/write, PR, CI and guarded-merge E2E before launch.
